title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.31002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. translated_title: RoboUniverse-10K：借助真实到仿真环境迈向智能体机器人的规模化时代
translated_abstract: 智能体机器人学是一种基础模型作为编码智能体、通过可执行程序来控制机器人的新范式，已成为具身智能领域极具吸引力的方向。然而，与软件工程中由海量可执行环境支撑后训练不同，机器人领域仍受限于规模小、需人工构建的基准测试以及分布内评估。为弥合这一差距，我们推出了RoboUniverse-10K：通过自动化的Real2Sim（真实到仿真）与质量保证流程，从真实世界视频构建的10,807个可交互、可重置且可验证的物理环境。每个环境均在隔离的、兼容Harbor的框架中运行，该框架隐藏特权状态与评分逻辑，以模拟真实世界的感知条件。基于同一流程，我们保留了500个未见过的任务，建立了RoboUniverse-Verified——一个经专家验证的零样本基准。对11个闭源与开源模型的评估揭示了巨大差距：前沿模型达到85.8%的成功率，而开源基线模型……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了RoboUniverse-10K——通过自动化Real2Sim与质量保证流程从真实视频构建的10,807个可交互、可重置、可验证的物理环境数据集，并配套专家验证的零样本基准RoboUniverse-Verified，为智能体机器人迈向规模化后训练与评估时代奠定基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RoboUniverse-10K, a suite of 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and QA pipeline, together with an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark (RoboUniverse-Verified), paving the way for the scaling era of agentic robotics.
